title: The Copper Kettle rota, week commencing 30 November 2026

constraints.rationale: Each shift gets exactly the number of people in its staff_needed column.

provenance.quote: shifts + how many people each one needs = shifts.csv

constraints.rationale: A kitchen shift needs someone who can work in the kitchen and a floor shift someone who can work on the floor (can_work column; Sam can do both).

provenance.quote: kitchen shifts only for kitchen people, floor shifts only for floor people (staff.csv says who can do what, Sam does both)

constraints.rationale: Legal minimum of 11 hours off between any two shifts of the same person (so no lunch-and-dinner doubles).

provenance.quote: at least eleven hours off between any two shifts, no exceptions - legal thing

constraints.rationale: Nobody works during their approved time off listed in time_off.csv.

provenance.quote: time off is in time_off.csv - all approved, so nobody works during their time off

constraints.rationale: At most 40 working hours this week for everyone.

provenance.quote: nobody over forty hours this week

constraints.rationale: Dan and Marco never work the same shift.

provenance.quote: never put Dan and Marco on the same shift!!

constraints.rationale: Ollie, who is new on the floor, should work the same shifts as Grace.

provenance.quote: Ollie is new on the floor - if poss put him on the same shifts as Grace so she can show him the ropes

constraints.rationale: Saturday and Sunday shifts are shared evenly across the whole team.

provenance.quote: share the weekend shifts (Sat + Sun) out evenly across everyone

constraints.rationale: Preferably no more than four consecutive working days.

provenance.quote: ideally no one works more than four days running

constraints.rationale: Everyone should get at least two shifts this week.

provenance.quote: everyone should get at least two shifts this week if at all possible
Sophie likes lunches, give her those when you can

constraints.rationale: Marco would rather not work on Sunday.

provenance.quote: Marco would rather not work Sunday

assumptions.text: The request for at least one personal licence holder on the floor every evening cannot be expressed in the catalog and is not enforced; it needs a human check.
Friday and Saturday dinners end at 00:30 the next day and count on the day they start.
